title: GPO Rationalization & Cleanup with Group Policy Analytics
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (pre-migration assessment + rationalization of a complex GPO estate using Intune Group Policy analytics; foundational, sells ahead of the actual migration).
hook: Clean up the GPO mess before you migrate — so the move to Intune is built on solid ground
problem: Years of Group Policy leave a thicket: nested and redundant policies, duplicate audit settings, and unclear intent that nobody fully understands. Migrating that mess to Intune as-is just moves the chaos. This solution is the foundational cleanup — inventory every GPO, use Intune Group Policy analytics to rationalize and de-duplicate, retire what's dead, document intent, and produce a clean, sequenced migration backlog — so the move to a modern Intune baseline starts from order, not sprawl.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — why rationalize before migrating, how Intune Group Policy analytics scores migration readiness, and the de-duplication / retire / consolidate / document workflow.
Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (access to export GPOs, Intune with Group Policy analytics, Entra ID, a rationalization owner) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: export and inventory all GPOs, import to Group Policy analytics, classify (keep / retire / consolidate / replace), resolve redundant audit and conflicting policies, document intent, and produce a sequenced migration backlog, then pilot and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — GPO export/inventory discovery, rationalization-coverage validation, a redundancy/conflict and readiness report, safe remediation of dead/duplicate links, and a migration-backlog/scope builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The foundational GPO cleanup before any Intune migration — inventory, rationalize with Group Policy analytics, retire the dead, document intent, and produce a sequenced migration backlog. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: The foundational GPO cleanup before any Intune migration — inventory, rationalize with Group Policy analytics, retire the dead, document intent, and produce a sequenced migration backlog.
